name: Jenny
request: It's good to see you're back in town.
I hope you've been taking good care of yourself.
Anyway. I'm here to order some flowers, please.
My cousin, Peter, suddenly passed away on Saturday,
I didn't know him all too well, in all honesty.
I've hardly seen him since we were kids.
I'd like something classic to honour him, please.
Auntie says he wouldn't have liked a big fuss anyway.
hints: Jenny said she'd like something classic to honour her cousin.
White lillies are described as 'classic, elegant flowers' in the handbook.
bonus_thankyou: And... oh wow, these white lillies are perfect.
What a beautiful way to honour his memory.
You know, Auntie's old dog was named Lily.
Peter and I used to walk her together when we were kids.
We'd tire ourselves out running around the park for hours at a time.
He was always much faster than me, but I never minded.
Huh. I haven't thought about those days with Lily and Peter in years.
Thank you, Willow, this is truly perfect.
